Interface MovementDirectionStrategy

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClockwiseMovementStrategy, CounterClockwiseMovementStrategy
public interface MovementDirectionStrategy
Strategy for the two directions in which a piece can travel: clockwise and counter-clockwise. The two directions move and measure the distance to the Approach cell in different ways, so the movement code asks this interface and never checks the direction itself.

    • countStepsToApproach

      int countStepsToApproach(int currentPosition, PlayerColor color, Board board)
      Counts the steps from a track cell to the Approach cell of a colour, in this direction.
      Parameters:
      currentPosition - the track position to start from
      color - the colour whose Approach cell is the target
      board - the board that gives the track
      Returns:
      the number of steps; 0 when the piece stands on the Approach cell

    • getRequiredApproachPassCount

      int getRequiredApproachPassCount()
      Gives the number of times a piece must pass its Approach cell before it may enter its HomeStraight.
      Returns:
      one for clockwise, two for counter-clockwise
